description:
The grants the ADEME, the French ecological transition agency, awarded to one French company since 2021,
from its open dataset of financial aid: date of the agreement, amount in euros, purpose, aid scheme and
decision reference, most recent first, with the total count.

Use this to answer "did X receive public aid from the ADEME", "what subsidies did X get for its energy
transition".

The dataset covers the ADEME alone: it is not all the public money a company received, and a company with
no ADEME grant may have received aid from another body. Grants are matched on the SIRET, never on the name.

siren.description: The nine-digit SIREN of a French legal entity. Spaces, dots and dashes are accepted. This is not a SIRET: drop the last five digits of a SIRET to get the SIREN.

name: get_french_company_ademe_grants
title: ADEME grants received by a French company
